claim.claim-text: 2. The acoustic panel of claim 1, wherein a first plurality of openings extends through the face sheet and into the first cavity.
3. The acoustic panel of claim 2, wherein the first cavity is configured to form a first Helmholtz resonator configured to dampen a first resonant frequency.
4. The acoustic panel of claim 2 or 3, wherein a second plurality of openings extends through the face sheet and into the second cavity.
5. The acoustic panel of claim 4, wherein the second cavity is configured to form a second Helmholtz resonator configured to dampen a second resonant frequency.

6. The acoustic panel of any of claims 1 to 5, wherein the first cavity defines an L-shaped space between the first wall and the second wall and the second cavity defines a rectangular shaped space between the first wall and the second wall.
